summary: Sign the bootc image with Sigstore: skopeo generate-sigstore-key --output-prefix signingkey, enable use-sigstore-attachments for the registry in /etc/containers/registries.d/<registry>.yaml, podman login, then podman push --sign-by-sigstore-private-key ./signingkey.private <repo>:<tag>.
questions: How do I sign a bootc image with Sigstore?
How do I push Sigstore signatures to my registry?

answer_card.title: Sign and push a bootc image with Sigstore
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
skopeo generate-sigstore-key --output-prefix signingkey
sudo tee "/etc/containers/registries.d/${OCI_REGISTRY}.yaml" > /dev/null <<EOF
docker:
    ${OCI_REGISTRY}:
        use-sigstore-attachments: true
EOF
sudo podman login ${OCI_REGISTRY}
sudo podman push --sign-by-sigstore-private-key ./signingkey.private \
    ${OCI_IMAGE_REPO}:${OCI_IMAGE_TAG}
```
